title: 第9章 巧遇第10章 傻了吧我也会
content_zh:
“咦？”楚墨疑惑的望向对门，“这是什么动静？”
赵阳似乎从昨日起就没回来过，此刻他的房门大开，两名黑袍人正毫不客气地翻检着里面的物品。
“两位师兄，敢问你们这是？”楚墨试探着问道。
两人中稍显年长的抬头看了一眼，见只是一个炼气二层的修士，便负手而立，语气平淡：
“我们是‘上陵商会’的人，此间主人已死，特来清点遗物，偿还他遗留的灵债。”
“赵阳死了？！”楚墨诧异地问，昨日竟一语成谶？
“没错，就在昨日夜晚，死亡原因不知。”年长修士点点头，语气没有起伏。
死个人而已，在宗门内可太常见了，至于死因他们更是懒得查，只要不影响收债就行。
“师兄，遗物清点完毕，价值在二十四枚法钱左右。”年轻修士停下手中动作，指着桌上的物品说道。
“那就算他二十法钱。他还剩多少贷款没清？”
年轻修士连忙翻开随身账本，片刻后念道：“姓名赵阳，炼气二层修士，累计借款二百二十一枚法钱，尚欠四百一十枚未还。”
楚墨听得瞠目，这小子怎么贷这么多？而且这利息高过头了吧？
“这样嘛。”年长修士摸摸自己的下巴，“那就从幡中唤出赵阳魂魄，为我上陵商会驱使五百年抵债吧。”
楚墨已经不想说话了，赵阳这是欠了个通天贷啊！死后都不得安宁。
年长修士挥手收起遗物，转而笑眯眯的对楚墨道：“我等还需向江师兄复命，就不与师弟闲聊了。
师弟要是缺法钱，记得来我们上陵商会，只需要一点小小的利息，就能保你修炼之途畅通无阻。”
“呵、呵......”楚墨干笑两声，抱拳道：“一定，一定。”
年长修士点头示意，接着两人架起灵云径直离开。
楚墨深深望了一眼对面空荡的屋子。这度厄宗内当真是危机四伏，一刻不得安宁
柳衔那老登还给自己下了任务，至少三瓶灵墨。制作这东西需要修士灵血，多了可是要影响日后修炼的。

当然这次任务奖励可能会很丰富。楚墨既想要奖励，又不想损害自身根基。
“要不......去买？”他猛地拍手。
这次面板奖励他三十法钱，外加三张市价三枚法钱左右的灼心符，买两瓶灵墨还是轻轻松松的。
心里打定主意，楚墨熟门熟路地拐进了去北崖的路上。
他算是看出来了，所谓的符师传承不过吊在眼前的胡萝卜。柳衔老登明目张胆的榨压自己的劳动力，还不给报酬。
等自己修为超过对方，一定给他点颜色瞧瞧。
北崖集会依旧热闹，来往者络绎不绝，楚墨目标明确的走到售卖材料的区域。
空气中弥漫着淡淡的腥气与药草混合的味道。
两侧摊位上，各种妖兽材料、矿物灵植琳琅满目，甚至不乏一些气息诡异、难以辨认的异界产物。
他目光扫过几个售卖液体材料的摊位，最终在一个种类齐全、摊主看起来颇为精明的修士面前停下。
摊主正拿着一块软布，慢条斯理地擦拭着一个玉瓶。
“这位师弟，需要点什么？”摊主抬头，露出一个生意人的和气笑容。
content_en:
"Huh?" Chu Mo looked at the opposite door in confusion, "What's this?"
Zhao Yang seemed to have not been back since yesterday. At this moment, his door was wide open, and two men in black robes were unceremoniously looking through the items inside.
"Two senior brothers, may I ask you what this is?" Chu Mo asked tentatively.
The older of the two looked up and saw that he was just a monk on the second level of Qi Refining. He stood with his hands behind his hands and said in a calm tone:
"We are members of the Shanngling Chamber of Commerce. The owner here has passed away. We are here to take stock of the relics and repay the spiritual debt he left behind."
"Zhao Yang is dead?!" Chu Mo asked in surprise, what he said yesterday actually came true?
"Yes, just last night, the cause of death is unknown." The older monk nodded, his tone unchanged.
It's just a person dying, which is very common in the sect. As for the cause of death, they don't bother to check, as long as it doesn't affect debt collection.
"Brother, the inventory of the relics has been completed. The value is about twenty-four French coins." The young monk stopped his movements and pointed to the items on the table.
"That's twenty francs. How many loans does he have left to pay off?"
The young monk quickly opened his personal account book and read after a moment: "My name is Zhao Yang. I am a second-level Qi Refining monk. I have borrowed a total of 221 dharma coins and still owe 410 dharma coins."
Chu Mo was stunned when he heard this, why did this kid borrow so much? And the interest rate is too high, right?
"That's it." The older monk touched his chin, "Then call out Zhao Yang's soul from the flag and help my Shanngling Chamber of Commerce pay off the debt for five hundred years."
Chu Mo didn't want to talk anymore. Zhao Yang owed a huge loan! There is no peace after death.
The older monk waved his hand and put away the relics, then turned to Chu Mo with a smile and said: "I will not chat with you anymore until I need to return my life to Senior Brother Jiang.
If junior brother is short of money, remember to come to our Shanngling Chamber of Commerce. It only requires a small amount of interest to ensure that your cultivation path is smooth. "
"Heh, heh..." Chu Mo laughed dryly, cupped his fists and said, "Definitely, definitely."
The older monk nodded, and then the two set up Lingyun and left.
Chu Mo took a deep look at the empty room opposite. This time, Ezong is really in danger, and there is no peace for a moment.
Liu Xian Na Lao Deng also gave himself a task, at least three bottles of spiritual ink. Making this thing requires a monk's spiritual blood, and if it is too much, it will affect your future cultivation.
Of course, the rewards for this mission may be very rich. Chu Mo wanted rewards, but he didn't want to damage his own foundation.
"How about... go buy it?" He clapped his hands violently.
This time the panel rewarded him with 30 dharma coins, plus three Heart-Scorching Talismans with a market price of about 3 dharma coins. It was easy to buy two bottles of spiritual ink.
Having made up his mind, Chu Mo turned onto the road to Beiya with a familiar path.
He finally saw that the so-called Talisman Master's inheritance was nothing more than a carrot dangled in front of his eyes. Liu Xianlaodeng blatantly exploited his own labor force without paying him.
When your cultivation level exceeds that of the other party, you must show him some color.
The Beiya gathering was still lively, with an endless stream of people coming and going. Chu Mo walked to the area where materials were sold with a clear purpose.
The air was filled with a faint smell of fish mixed with herbs.
On the stalls on both sides, there is a dazzling array of all kinds of monster materials, minerals and spiritual plants, and there are even some products from other worlds with strange smells and difficult to identify.
He glanced at several stalls selling liquid materials, and finally stopped in front of a monk with a full range of products and a stall owner who looked quite shrewd.
The stall owner was holding a soft cloth and slowly wiping a jade bottle.
"Junior brother, what do you need?" The stall owner looked up and showed a businessman's kind smile.
